descriptions.General Description: ST's one-paragraph marketing summary of the device
descriptions.Marketing Status: Lifecycle state of the part at ST
descriptions.Package: Package type(s) the part is offered in
descriptions.Operating Frequency (MHz): Maximum CPU clock frequency in MHz
descriptions.Co-Processor type: Type of secondary processor core(s) on the device
descriptions.Co-Processor frequency (MHz) max: Maximum clock frequency of the co-processor in MHz
descriptions.Dual-bank Flash: Whether the Flash memory is organised in two banks
descriptions.CCM RAM (I/D) (kByte) typ: Core-coupled memory (instruction and data) in KiB (typical)
descriptions.Advanced Motor Control Timers: Number of timers with advanced motor-control capability (typical)
descriptions.Other timer functions: Timer features beyond the counted general-purpose set
descriptions.Display controller: Which display interfaces (LCD-TFT, MIPI-DSI, ...) are supported
descriptions.I/Os (High Current): Number of pins rated for high sink/source current (typical)
descriptions.Additional Interfaces: Extra communication interfaces beyond the counted USART / UART / I2C / SPI sets
descriptions.External Memory Interfaces: External memory bus types (FSMC / FMC / Octo-SPI, ...)
descriptions.USB Type: Which USB roles / interfaces the device supports
descriptions.Security Functions: Security features beyond cryptography (secure storage, tamper, ...)
descriptions.Ethernet: Ethernet MAC interfaces supported and their speed
descriptions.Supply Current (µA) (@ Lowest Power) typ: Current draw at the lowest-power setting in µA (typical)
descriptions.Supply Current (µA) (Run Mode (per MHz)): Current draw per MHz while running, in µA/MHz (typical)
descriptions.Output Power (dBm) min: Minimum RF output power in dBm
descriptions.Output Power (dBm) max: Maximum RF output power in dBm
descriptions.RX current (mA) typ: Radio receiver current draw in mA (typical)
descriptions.Standby Current (µA) typ: Current draw in standby / lowest-power mode in µA (typical)
descriptions.TX current (mA) (@ 0dBm) max: Radio transmit current at 0 dBm in mA (maximum)
descriptions.Output Power (dBm) (Step) typ: Number of configurable RF output-power steps (typical)
descriptions.Connectivity supported: Which communication standards the device implements
descriptions.Longevity Commitment (yr) typ: Years ST commits to keeping the part available (typical)
descriptions.Longevity Starting Date: Date the longevity commitment begins to count from
